_description: This shows the raw data structures used to simulate and verify network divergence in PlaneSplit.

internal_routing_packet._note: This represents the pure algorithmic Packet object passing through the Longest Prefix Match (LPM) router tables in Python.

telemetry_event_payload._note: This is the enriched packet telemetry event sent over WebSockets to the 3D frontend after the Control Plane and Data Plane paths are compared.
